Title: TOM: Q: Justicar Retribution and Spying Mission

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Would a successful Justicar Retribution vote burn a standard (1-bleed)
vampire with a Spying Mission?

That is, does the spying mission only apply at the moment the next
bleed is successful, or at all times until that point?
--

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
L. Scott Johnson <sjoh...@math.scarolina.edu> wrote:
>Would a successful Justicar Retribution vote burn a standard (1-bleed)
>vampire with a Spying Mission?
>That is, does the spying mission only apply at the moment the next
>bleed is successful, or at all times until that point?

The +2 bleed only kicks in under the condition described by Spying Mission,
so wouldn't be counted by Justicar Retribution etc.

Tom Wylie rec.games.trading-cards.* Network Representative for
aa...@cats.ucsc.edu Wizards of the Coast, Inc.

Messages.Author: Zach Haffey
Messages.Body:
On 16 Apr 1996, L. Scott Johnson wrote:

> Would a successful Justicar Retribution vote burn a standard (1-bleed)
> vampire with a Spying Mission?
>

It wouldn't burn the vampire. The spying mission doesn't give the vampire
a current bleed of +2. It's the next time that that vampire attempts to
bleed the "mission"ed methuselah it's at +2, like they'd played a Gov.
the Unaligned, for example.

You can, however, say goodbye to all the Inner Circle Members, and Vamps
with Pulse.

-Zach

governing the unaligned, and then adding a conditioning...16 BLEED! The
power, children!! The power!!!!!

Well, the Force of Will bleed would only be for 17, since you would no
longer have the Spying Mission, but the combination would still
be pretty deadly :-).

Any Prey dumb enough not to have blocked one of the Three equip/employ
actions, or the four actions required to raise Inver.Scot to +3 bleed,
or have rushed Etrius during that time (min. four turns after Etrius
comes out assuming you have Heidelburg out and the luck of the draw is
with you), or Golconda'ed Etrius, or Sudden Reversaled the Legendary
Vampire play or one of the Fortitude skill card plays, or *bounce* or at
least block either of the monster bleeds deserves to be ousted :-[

We are talking about a 10 card, 3 master phase (4 with Heidelburg),
10 action (2 directed, 8 undirected) combination here.

There are probably easier ways of doing things.
